title: Mental Health Therapist - Missouri
description:
About NOCD
NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.
About the Role
As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.
NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LPC, LMFT, LCSW) in Missouri to join our team.
As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.
You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.
What You'll Do

• Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform

• Manage your caseload and schedule

• Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system

• Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD

• Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

• See credentialing information here.

• Full Time Providers:

•

• 40 hour work week

• Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week

• Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.

• Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation

• Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions

• Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding

• Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training

• Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).

•

• If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.

• Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

• Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.

•

• Communicate with clients regarding customer service issues that require specialized casting knowledge.

• Perform other responsibilities and tasks as assigned.

title: Data Center Hardware Quality & Reliability Engineer
description:
About The Role

Own the end-to-end data-center hardware quality and reliability loop for OpenAI’s 3P infrastructure and 1P current and next-gen platforms. Turn field failures into quantified risk, fast containment, verified root cause, improved MQE/NPI and manufacturing-test coverage, accurate spares forecasts, and upstream changes that prevent recurrence.

The first hire must combine practical hardware/system understanding, reliability engineering, data fluency, and cross-functional technical leadership at data-center scale.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and govern the field-quality data model across telemetry, tickets, RMA/repair, FA, firmware, configuration, supplier, and manufacturing genealogy.

• Define AFR, ASR, DPPM, MTBF/MTTR, repeat-repair, NTF, repair-cycle-time, and forecast-versus-actual metrics with explicit denominators and uncertainty.

• Provide fleet-level macro views and unit/FRU/cohort-level micro views; detect shifts and bound affected populations.

• Lead systemic field-failure triage, containment, failure analysis, 8D/CAPA, risk assessment, corrective-action verification, and recurrence monitoring.

• Develop cohort, life-data, reliability-growth, and spare-demand projections by product, FRU, supplier, configuration, geography, and age.

• Partner with MQE and NPI to convert field mechanisms into manufacturing-test coverage, screening/stress profiles, diagnostics, control plans, DFR/DFS requirements, FMEA/FTA, mission profiles, FRU strategy, and qualification gates.

• Close the loop by verifying whether upstream changes reduce field recurrence.

• Define supplier/CM FA standards, field-data contracts, scorecards, escalation paths, and closure evidence.

• Provide serviceability, TCO, and spares inputs without owning inventory execution or procurement.

• Create concise executive decision packages: population at risk, exposure, confidence, options, cost/risk, and recommendation.

• Run the cross-functional reliability council and, as the team grows, mentor the 1P and 3P Field Quality Engineers.

Qualifications

• BS in electrical, mechanical, computer, materials, reliability engineering, physics, or equivalent experience; MS preferred.

• 8+ years in hardware quality/reliability, server/rack systems, or mission-critical infrastructure; 3+ years owning field-failure, RMA, or CAPA outcomes.

• Solid working understanding of hardware and system architecture across board, tray, rack, firmware, telemetry, manufacturing test, and fleet behavior; deep expertise in every subsystem is not required.

• Reliability statistics: censored life data, Weibull/Poisson/binomial methods, confidence bounds, MTBF/MTTR, and reliability growth.

• Hands-on FMEA/FTA, accelerated or reliability-demonstration testing, 8D/CAPA, FA, and corrective-action verification.

• Working proficiency with SQL and Python/R or equivalent analytics tools.

• Ability to influence design, validation, operations, suppliers/CMs, and senior leaders without direct authority.

Preferred Skills

• GPU/AI server platforms, liquid cooling, high-power delivery, high-speed networking, rack integration, or data-center operations.

• Design for serviceability: FRU boundaries, diagnostics, repair workflows, tooling/access, and spares policy.

• Qualification-to-field correlation and mission-profile development.

• ODM/CM/supplier experience: FA quality, audit, QBR, and corrective-action governance.

• Linux/BMC/IPMI/Redfish logs and fleet telemetry.

• Leadership of a cross-generation reliability program or launch-readiness gate.

title: Regulatory Affairs Advisor
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Title: Regulatory Advisor - FDA Pharma & IVDR

Natera is a clinical genetic testing company specializing in non-invasive, cell-free DNA (cfDNA) and liquid biopsy testing . The Regulatory Advisor plays a key role in developing and driving regulatory strategy on behalf of the regulatory affairs (RA) team, specifically focusing on FDA Pharma and IVDR initiatives. At Natera, we remember there is a person behind every sample . This role combines strong technical knowledge and an understanding of regulatory requirements (US FDA, CAP/CLIA/NYS, EU, or Japan) to support the approval and registration of products that proactively inform disease management .

You will represent the RA team to internal and external stakeholders through written and verbal communication. This role maintains product registrations, change assessments, post-market surveillance reports, and records of communication with regulatory authorities. You will support the overall effectiveness of the RA team through contributions to staff development, process improvements, and maintaining a deep understanding of current regulatory requirements in the evolving diagnostics landscape.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

•
Represent the regulatory function on designated cross-functional teams.

•
Conduct business interactions with customers and regulatory authorities regarding regulatory pathways, performance claims, supporting data, and labeling in the context of submissions or registrations.

•
Build and execute bold, practical regulatory strategies for complex regulatory affairs programs, with a heavy emphasis on FDA Pharma, IVDR, and In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) systems.

•
Advocate for the least burdensome approaches to product clearance and approval while strictly interpreting and adhering to regulatory requirements.

•
Coordinate and prepare regulatory submissions with minimal supervision, including EU/IVD/IVDR Technical Documentation, classification requests, pre-submissions, 510(k) premarket notifications, investigational device exemptions, NYS DoH submissions, and critical worldwide registrations.

•
Mentor regulatory associates and support their career advancement.

•
Deliver training on regulatory topics across internal teams.

•
Lead cross-functional teams to address major regulatory changes, compliance with new registration requirements, or process improvements.

•
Contribute to setting individual and departmental annual goals aligned with business objectives.

•
Review and ensure regulatory compliance of advertising, promotion, and labeling across a common product line.

•
Take personal accountability for identifying gaps in processes and proactively build data-driven solutions to improve them .

•
Evaluate product changes for global regulatory submission impact.

•
May lead small teams.

•
Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

•
Bachelor’s degree in a life science field (biology, microbiology, chemistry, engineering, medical technology, regulatory science, etc.) or equivalent. Advanced degree in life sciences (MS, PhD, etc.) and/or MBA preferred.

•
Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) preferred.

•
Minimum of 8+ years of direct applicable regulatory experience in medical devices, laboratory-developed tests (LDTs), or pharma.

•
Direct experience with FDA Pharma and IVDR submissions is highly preferred.

•
Experience in Organ Health or Women's Health diagnostics is ideal and strongly preferred.

•
In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) and Companion Diagnostics (CDx) experience is a plus.

•
PMA experience preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

•
Working knowledge of U.S. and EU Medical Device/IVD/IVDR, FDA Pharma, and/or laboratory developed test regulatory requirements.

•
Proactive, self-directed, and highly engaged.

•
Emphasis on talent development and team building.

•
Use sound scientific judgment to solve problems and make decisions even when rigid policies do not exist .

•
Manage multiple projects with urgency, staying organized

The Core Model Safety team builds foundational capabilities for assisted and automated driving - collision avoidance, model understanding, and robustness under failure. - You have excellent experimental judgement: able to turn an ambiguous behavioral problem into falsifiable hypotheses, useful metrics, disciplined ablations, and clear technical decisions.

- You bring senior-level ownership and collaboration: able to lead a substantial technical area, work across research and engineering boundaries, and bring others along through clear written and verbal communication.

Desirable

- Prior experience in autonomous vehicles or robotics with hands-on deployment and closed-loop validation on physical systems.

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Policy/Research Intern - Competitive Enterprise Institute
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About Competitive Enterprise Institute:
 
The Competitive Enterprise Institute is a nonprofit think tank based in Washington which focuses on critical economic and regulatory policy issues.
 
CEI’s internship program provides interested students and recent graduates the opportunity to learn about and promote the principles of limited government, free enterprise, and individual liberty. A CEI internship gives applicants the opportunity to work alongside some of the most prominent regulatory affairs scholars and policy specialists.
 
CEI offers a number of internships across the various policy areas we work on, as well as internships in communications and marketing. Generally, CEI’s policy interns are assigned to work with a specific CEI expert for the duration of their internship; and our communications and marketing interns work with the CEI staff of each respective team.
 
CEI’s internship program is an invaluable educational experience. We work with interns to help them grow professionally, hone their skills, and cultivate lasting relationships. Ultimately, our goal is to give interns work that will help them further their careers. Interns are encouraged to be proactive, and exceptional interns are often given the freedom to shape their experience with us and the possibility to explore other opportunities at CEI.
 
Past CEI interns have gone on to work in the executive and legislative branches, federal regulatory agencies, academia, and at prominent research institutions and think tanks. A number of current CEI staff are former CEI interns.
 
You can find out more about CEI here and learn about our history here. You can see our team of experts here and see some of our work here and here.
 
Policy/Research Intern:
Policy/Research Interns are assigned to work with one or more CEI policy experts for the duration of their internship. Interns have the opportunity to research important policy issues which include, but are not limited to; regulatory reform, banking and finance, energy and environment, technology and telecommunications, antitrust, trade, labor, transportation, healthcare, and asset forfeiture.
 
Qualifications:
Applicants must have a strong interest in policy and politics, capitalism and economics, and libertarian/conservative principles. Applicants must have strong research, writing, and organizational skills. Applicants must possess a professional demeanor and the ability to handle confidential and private information. Applicants should be able to work independently, effectively, and efficiently. A basic understanding of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook is a must.
 
CEI also seeks interns to work on communications, marketing - and from time to time, philanthropy/fundraising, government affairs, events, litigation, and IT. During the interview, we would be more than happy to discuss these other opportunities if they are available and of interest to you!
 
This role is in person, in Washington, D.C.

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

【岗位职责】

一、行情与实时数据系统

1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。

2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。

3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。

二、链上数据中台建设

1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。

2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。

3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。

4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳

Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。

Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。

8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有大数据实时与离线计算经验（Flink、Spark、Storm 等），熟悉 Lambda / Kappa 架构。

2.有 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）池子状态维护、价格计算、聚合行情相关经验。

3.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、抢跑保护等相关经验。

4.有时序数据库（如 TimescaleDB、Druid、ClickHouse）在行情场景下的落地经验。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

title: Lead Account Executive, Commerce Growth
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

The Account Executive, Commerce Growth owns a new-business revenue number across Darkroom's commerce practice: Amazon (marketplace management and retail media), TikTok Shop and social commerce, Retention Marketing (email, SMS, lifecycle), and Digital Products (GEO / AI-search, SEO, CRO, web builds, and web support).

You lead with the marketplaces. Amazon and TikTok Shop are where your hunt starts - these are a couple of the highest-intent entry points in the market right now, and the fastest route into a brand's commerce P&L. Retention and Digital Products are how you widen the deal: once you are inside a brand's commerce operation, you are the person who sees that their email program is flat, their PDPs do not convert, and they are invisible in AI search - and who scopes and closes that work too.

You are a commercial, closer-minded operator who builds a book through partnerships, industry events, and targeted outreach - and who also fields and closes the inbound that arrives in your practice. You will become the person the market associates with Darkroom's commerce offering: at the conferences, in the platform partner ecosystems, and in the rooms where these deals get done.

You will also own the upsell and cross-sell motion for your departments - working the existing client base alongside our Managing Directors and Will Margaritis (SVP, Strategy) to identify and close expansion into your services.

This is a high-accountability role with clear revenue KPIs and uncapped commission that rewards self-sourced pipeline. If you want to own the commerce practice, build a durable network, and close tech-enabled marketing services you believe in, this is the role for you.

Location: NYC strongly preferred.

YOUR PRACTICE

You own new business and expansion across four service clusters. The first two lead; the second two attach.

Lead with:

- Amazon - marketplace strategy and management, catalog and content, Amazon Ads / retail media, and DSP.

- TikTok Shop & Social Commerce - shop setup and operations, affiliate and creator-led selling, live and Spark Ads-driven commerce, and the adjacent social marketplaces as they mature.

Attach and expand into:

- Retention Marketing - email, SMS, and lifecycle (Klaviyo and the broader retention stack).

- Digital Products - GEO / AI-search optimization, SEO, conversion-rate optimization, web builds, and ongoing web support.

title: Oncology Field Medical Director, Thoracic (non-MD)
description:
Lung cancer treatment is evolving rapidly, and the space between emerging evidence and every day clinical practice is where our medical expertise matters most.

As a field-based scientific expert supporting Pfizer ’s Thoracic oncology portfolio in Michigan and Ohio (MI/OH)., you will engage a broad range of medical customer segments. You will deliver approved medical and scientific education to healthcare professionals, surface insights that inform medical strategy, support the identification of potential clinical trial sites and clinical trial support, and help address the field’s most important unanswered scientific questions in service of improving patient outcomes.

Field Medical Core Responsibilities

• Plan and execute Medical strategy and engagement for appropriate assigned customers within a territory, compliantly coordinating with other Pfizer colleagues as needed to achieve Medical objectives

• Maintain required level of knowledge of relevant TA/disease states and Pfizer medicines, providing therapeutic area/product information to both internal and external stakeholders as needed

• Serve as a conduit and resource for Medical Information and customer insights, providing requested information to HCPs as allowed by Pfizer guidance and sharing customer viewpoints with Pfizer as appropriate

• Understand the priorities of Pfizer Medical Affairs in order to contribute to Medical content strategy development and execute aligned Field Medical tactics

• Maintain effective and appropriate communication and collaboration among headquarters Medical colleagues, Medical Information, and other Pfizer Field Medical colleagues

• Demonstrate expertise in communication across multiple channels, including, but not limited to, live and virtual presentations in small or large settings, written communication, and telephone or virtual conversations

• Optimize patient centricity of Medical communications and deliverables, incorporating Health Literacy and cultural awareness principles to ensure that patients remain the ultimate focus

Field Medical: Additional Responsibilities

• Deliver approved medical content about Pfizer medicines and relevant topics in the designated therapeutic area.

• Identify and seek medical engagement from priority customer segments in assigned Therapeutic Area.

• Provide truthful, accurate, and scientifically supported information in response to direct unsolicited medical requests from HCPs in a manner that complies with all applicable Pfizer guidelines, policies, and procedures.

• Leads advisory boards, working with vendors if necessary, with manager oversight.

• Field relevant inbound queries from HCPs via established triage process.

• In collaboration with Global Medical Affairs colleagues, partner with Oncology Research & Development and Global Product Development (GPD) in the identification of potential sites for Pfizer -sponsored clinical trials, including identification of sites serving under-represented patient populations in trials.

• Appropriately provide Medical support throughout the Investigator Sponsored Research (ISR) process.

• Cultivate research and therapeutic area expertise, including familiarity with latest congress data and disease state literature.

• Provides Asset leadership.

• Understand the principles of study design, methodology, data analysis, and interpretation and communicate these concepts with customers.

• Lead your territory with an ownership mindset: strategic planning, disciplined prioritization, and full accountability for medical impact in your geography.

• Reactively and proactively communicate with local Patient Advocacy Group(s), as appropriate, in close collaboration with Corporate Affairs and HQ Medical Affairs.

• Deliver actionable field insights - local patient organization structure, capabilities, patient population needs, real-world treatment patterns, evolving standards of care, and unmet data needs - to inform medical strategy and evidence generation.

title: Operations Expert, Aerospace & Defense (US)
description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.  

Airspace has been rated one of  America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of  CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m. 

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics. 

 

Be Your Sector's Highest-Level Resource

Every escalation eventually reaches someone who's seen it before - who can look at a complex shipment, an account-level curveball, or a live volume spike and know exactly what to do. As an Ops Expert, you're that person for your sector.

Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist III job description, in addition to the following:

Resolve What Escalates Beyond the Team

• Independently resolve all escalated issues, including those surfaced by teammates, account managers, and leadership

• Serve as a key knowledge point for complex shipments and situations within your sector

• Contribute reference and knowledge to teammates and leadership to support account-level improvements

Coach and Lead in Real Time

• Guide teammates in real time when errors or issues occur, not retroactively

• Lead a remote team through live volume fluctuations and customer encounters

• Evaluate process adherence and flag live training opportunities within your team

• Identify team training gaps and partner with supervisors to address them

• Support prioritization and workload balancing within your sector assignment

Monitor and Allocate Live Operations

• Monitor core service and communication platforms (e.g., ticketing, calling, live dashboards) and allocate team resources appropriately

• Monitor on-shift team activity and process adherence across those same platforms

• Monitor high-visibility and swarm-level orders and processes

• Leverage all available training, informational, and departmental resources to inform decisions

Operate the Airspace Platform at the Expert Level

• Maintain any additional certifications required for the Expert tier and remain current on related requirements; answer related questions from teammates

• Quote and source coverage for specialized transport requests (e.g., on-board courier, charter) as needed

LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. ABOUT THE ROLE

The ways customers buy from us are multiplying as fast as the business is growing. Enterprise order forms. Private offers through AWS, GCP, and Azure. A self-serve business running on usage-based pricing, with commits, drawdowns, and true-ups behind it. Each one is a distinct path from signature to cash, and each one runs today on some mix of manual steps and automation that grew up with the business.

This role owns what comes next. You'll run order operations end to end - booking, provisioning, invoicing, amendments, and renewals - on a stack we picked deliberately and recently: Salesforce, Metronome for metering and billing, Rillet for ERP. The stack is modern, but the processes on top of it were built to keep up with growth, not designed to scale. Our bias is to invest in systems rather than in a growing queue of manual work, so you'll be setting the automation roadmap at the same time you're operating the function - deciding what a person should touch, what a workflow should handle, and what should never have been a step in the first place. Getting that right is what lets order volume grow by an order of magnitude without ops growing with it.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own order operations, working closely with Deal Strategy and Operations, GTM Systems, Finance and Accounting, and Enterprise Engineering. Those teams are your partners and much of your build capacity. Bringing them onto one shared order-to-cash roadmap is a core part of the job, and the reason we're hiring someone senior to do it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build out cloud marketplace operations across AWS, GCP, and Azure: private offer setup, usage reporting to each marketplace, and reconciling marketplace disbursements back to what we billed. Every new channel launches against defined readiness criteria, so marketplace deals run on the same clean path as direct ones

- Own self-serve billing operations: usage metering, plan changes, dunning, credits, rebills, refunds, and the escalations behind them

title: Warehouse Lead/Koordinátor úseku skladu
description:
Do našeho týmu v Brně hledáme zodpovědného a energického parťáka, který dokáže udržet ve skladu pořádek, rytmus a dobrou náladu. Pokud tě baví organizace práce, komunikace a máš chuť věci posouvat dál, tahle pozice je pro tebe jako stvořená!

Co tě u nás čeká?

- Sklad v dokonalém rytmusu: Zajistíš, aby všechny části skladu měly vyvážené množství práce a objednávky se plynule expedovaly až k našim kurýrům.

- Organizace týmu v provozu: Podle aktuální potřeby budeš operativně přesouvat pracovníky mezi sektory a hlídat jejich produktivitu.

- Budeš znát provoz skrz naskrz: Postupně kompletně ovládneš všechny klíčové pozice ve skladu - od příjmu zboží až po jeho expedici.

- Propojování týmů: Budeš úzce spolupracovat s kolegy napříč celou firmou a starat se o hladkou komunikaci mezi týmy.

- Prostor pro tvé nápady: Přijdeš s nápady, jak zlepšit pracovní prostředí i samotné procesy? Sem s nimi, tvoje iniciativa u nás bude vítaná!

- Směnový provoz: Práce probíhá v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden s 12hodinovými směnami (ranní a odpolední směny).

Jak si tě představujeme?

- Rychlé rozhodování: Dokážeš se pohotově rozhodnout i v situacích, kdy běžné postupy nestačí. Hledáš řešení, ne výmluvy.

- Neztratíš hlavu: Zachováš si klid a přehled, i když se toho ve skladu děje hodně najednou.

- Férový přístup: Jsi objektivní při řešení každodenních situací a případných sporů mezi kolegy na směně.

- Skvělý komunikátor: Máš výborné komunikační dovednosti a dokážeš jasně vysvětlit svá rozhodnutí i směr, kterým tým vedeš.

- Kamarádíš se s čísly: Umíš pracovat s daty - chápeš jejich souvislosti a dokážeš z nich vyvodit správné závěry pro provoz.

- Spokojenost zákazníka je pro tebe přirozenou prioritou a víš, že na každém kroku ve skladu záleží.

Co ti za tvou skvělou práci nabídneme?

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupuj s 10% cashbackem (kredity se ti vrátí na další nákupy).

- Čas na odpočinek - možnost placeného volna, když si potřebuješ pořádně vydechnout nebo si něco zařídit.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - přímo na pracovišti tě čeká dobré jídlo, skvělé kafe a čerstvé ovoce každý den.

- Sbírej hvězdičky a ulov si odměnu - máme super systém vnitrofiremních pochval. S kolegy si navzájem posíláte hvězdičky, které pak snadno proměníš za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - ke každé směně ti přihodíme 86 Kč navíc.

- Multisport karta - pro tvůj sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - umíme vzít za práci, ale i společně oslavit úspěchy na skvělých večírcích.

title: Venture Capital AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from venture capital, from seed to growth stage, who build cap tables, round models and exit waterfalls in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the modelling work of a Venture Capital Associate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in venture capital, startup finance or venture law, covering seed to growth-stage rounds

- Deep hands-on Excel: cap tables, SAFE and note conversions, liquidation preferences, nested formulas and named ranges

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

title: Field Marketing & Campaigns Manager
description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts - accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, https://www.permitflow.com/blog/permitflow-series-b from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7401703305569275904/, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.

This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.

This is a manager-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.

- Run logistics end to end: venues, budgets, vendors, contractors, staffing, and the on-the-ground run of show.

- Experiment deliberately and iterate quickly: test new formats, venues, and target audiences, and kill what doesn't work.

- Get the right targets in the room and at our booth. Great events don't stop at a project plan; they rely on driving high-value attendees.

- Connect events to revenue: define what success looks like for each event, track pipeline and revenue impact, and report results back to the business.

- Partner cross-functionally: work closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales, CS, and business operations to align events with GTM priorities.

- Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.

- Build the playbook: turn what's worked into repeatable processes so the program scales as the business grows.

- Represent events at the leadership level: bring recommendations and results directly to company leadership.

- Source speaking opportunities at relevant industry and public events for executive leadership, including content submissions as needed.

WHO YOU ARE

- 4-7+ years running B2B events in a fast-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.

- You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.

• Strong programming skills with a proficiency in Python or bash

• Exposure to building AI-assisted applications

• Supports the maintenance of marketed product applications (i.e., NDAs and MAAs)

• Maintains current knowledge of applicable regulatory requirements and performs assigned activities in accordance with company procedures and applicable regulations

• Adapts to changing priorities and contributes to practical, solution-oriented problem-solving

• Ability to organize and manage multiple assignments from different stakeholders while meeting established timelines and quality expectations

• Ability to work effectively both as a collaborative team member and as an individual contributor, with appropriate guidance

Preferred Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree (M.S., Pharm.D., Ph.D.) in life sciences (including chemistry, molecular biology, or similar) preferred

title: Research Intern, ClickHouse Labs
description:
PROGRAM OVERVIEW

The ClickHouse PhD Research Internship Program offers doctoral students the opportunity to pursue ambitious research alongside ClickHouse Labs researchers and engineers working on some of the most interesting challenges in databases, systems, and data infrastructure.

Research interns join ClickHouse Labs for approximately 10-12 weeks to explore meaningful research questions, develop new ideas, and investigate technologies that have the potential to advance both the broader research community and the future of ClickHouse.

The program is intentionally designed around research collaboration. Interns are paired with experienced researchers and have the opportunity to pursue work that aligns with their academic interests, ongoing research, and areas of interest within ClickHouse Labs. In some cases, an internship may build on research, a prototype, or a system the student has already begun exploring at their university.

We believe the strongest research relationships extend beyond a single summer. Interns may continue their work after returning to their university through academic research, open-source contributions, publications, or other forms of collaboration. Where there is a strong mutual fit, an internship may become the beginning of a longer-term relationship between the researcher, ClickHouse Labs, and the broader academic community.

During their internship, researchers will have the opportunity to work closely with ClickHouse Labs, engage with ClickHouse's open-source technology and engineering community, share their findings, and contribute to the intellectual life of the broader research community.

Program length: 10-12 weeks, with flexibility based on academic calendars and research needs

Typical timing: Summer, beginning approximately June 1

Locations: Opportunities available across the US and Europe, subject to role and employment requirements. Remote first.

Research environment: ClickHouse Labs

Internship format: Research-focused, mentor-supported, and shaped around areas of mutual research interest

Compensation: commensurate with experience, a monthly stipend will be paid

RESEARCH AT CLICKHOUSE LABS

ClickHouse Labs explores ambitious ideas at the intersection of databases, distributed systems, data infrastructure, and the broader systems research community.

We believe some of the most interesting advances in these areas happen through close collaboration between industry and academia. ClickHouse Labs brings together researchers and engineers to explore new ideas, investigate challenging technical problems, and connect academic research with real-world systems at scale.

Research interns are an important part of that community. Interns have the opportunity to bring their own research interests and perspectives into ClickHouse Labs while working alongside researchers and engineers who are deeply engaged with both the practical challenges and open research questions shaping the future of data systems.

PROGRAM GOALS

1. Identify exceptional PhD researchers working in areas directly relevant to ClickHouse.

2. Give researchers the opportunity to work on meaningful, open-ended problems with ClickHouse Labs.

3. Build long-term relationships with researchers and academic institutions.

4. Encourage continued research and open-source contributions after the internship.

5. Create opportunities for co-authored papers, thesis advising, or other academic collaboration.

6. Increase ClickHouse's visibility within the database and systems research community.

7. Publish and share meaningful research outcomes through the ClickHouse website and other appropriate channels.

title: Data/ML engineer, fusion data
description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future. Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform. We are looking for a Data / Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This job is for you if you like turning large, messy, heterogeneous experimental data into clean, labelled, trustworthy datasets. You have done this with scientific or industrial sensor data. Familiarity with fusion is a plus but not a strict requirement. Responsibilities Build, maintain and run pipelines that bring experimental fusion data into high quality, consistent, documented, versioned datasets. Develop ML-assisted labelling and event detection (e.g. disruptions, MHD activity, diagnostic faults), using weak supervision, active learning and anomaly detection. Own data quality and provisioning: provenance, calibration metadata, automated validation. Manage and facilitate access for the rest of the team. Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels. Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data. Requirements Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr). Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.</

title: Real Estate Sales Agent
description:
Real Estate Sales Agent
The voice that turns a quiet client database into real conversations about buying or selling.
Sector
Real Estate - US-based.
Reports to
Real Estate Agent
Type
Full-time
Hours
Full overlap with Pacific Time required
Rate
$4-$6/hr USD - DOE
Location
Fully remote
Tools
Contact list (previously used Follow Up Boss and RealGeeks), email, SMS/text platform, Facebook, Instagram
Role Overview
This role reactivates our client's existing database of past clients, referrals, and leads through email, text, and social media outreach - generating renewed interest in buying or selling a home. The Real Estate Sales Executive does not close deals; they generate and qualify interest, then hand off warm conversations to the agents for closing.
Key Responsibilities
Database Outreach & Reactivation

• Send emails and text messages to contacts in the client's database to reopen the conversation about buying or selling

• Track outreach activity: who was contacted, who responded, and who needs follow-up

• Personalize outreach based on each contact's history (past client, old lead, referral)

Social Media Outreach

• Reach out to relevant contacts via Facebook and Instagram messages

• Identify and engage people showing buying or selling signals on social platforms

• Keep messaging warm and personal - this is relationship reactivation, not cold advertising

Lead Qualification & Handoff

• Identify when a contact shows genuine interest in buying or selling

• Log conversation context clearly so the agents can pick it up without missing anything

• Hand off qualified conversations promptly so momentum isn't lost

Tracking & Reporting

• Keep a simple, current record of outreach activity and responses

• Flag which messages get replies and which contacts are warming up

Who Will Succeed
This role is steady, repetitive, and relationship-driven. The person who thrives here doesn't get discouraged by silence or 'no' - they stay warm, consistent, and genuinely curious about people.

• You're comfortable with repetitive outreach and don't take non-responses personally

• You write and message in a natural, warm tone - never scripted or salesy

• You're organized - nothing you send or hear back goes untracked

• You're comfortable on social media and know how to message people without feeling like a stranger

• You use AI tools to draft and personalize outreach faster, without losing the human touch

• You know the difference between generating interest and closing a deal - and you're energized by the first part

Experience & Skills

•
Required: Some familiarity with real estate concepts (buying/selling process, what a lead or database contact looks like) - not necessarily an expert

•
Required: Some experience with outreach, ISA (inside sales), or lead generation work - cold or warm outreach experience counts

•
Required: Strong written English - emails, texts, and DMs represent the client directly; writing is assessed at screening

•
Required: AI expertise - genuinely skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for drafting, personalizing, and speeding up outreach; this is a real capability, not casual use, and will be assessed

•
Required: Full overlap with Pacific Time required - not partial coordination

•
Required: Comfortable managing outreach across multiple channels (email, SMS, Facebook, Instagram) at once

-Preferred: Prior experience with a real estate CRM or database system

Das Fachwissen bringen wir dir bei. Auch Führungserfahrung brauchst du nicht: Wir zeigen dir Schritt für Schritt, wie du ein Team am Telefon coachst und gut führst. Was man nicht lernen kann: deine Schlagfertigkeit, deine positive Energie und deinen Willen, mehr aus dir zu machen.

Über den Job:
Wir generieren für über 500 Handwerksbetriebe und Küchenstudios im D-A-CH-Raum täglich Anfragen über Social Media. Unser Callcenter ruft diese Interessenten an und qualifiziert sie vor. Für unser zweites, komplett remote arbeitendes Team suchen wir eine Teamleitung, die selbst gerne telefoniert, das Team coacht und vorangeht.
Dein Weg: vom Quereinstieg in die Teamleitung:
1. Ankommen: Du lernst unser System direkt am Telefon kennen und wirst persönlich trainiert.
2. Coachen: Du übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Call-Reviews und Feedback im Team.
3. Führen: Du leitest das Remote-Team eigenverantwortlich und baust es mit uns aus.

• Strukturiertes Onboarding: Einarbeitungsplan mit persönlichem Training zu Leads, Gesprächsleitfäden und Systemen.

• Klare Abläufe: Saubere Anleitungen und Schulungen, damit jeder weiß, was zu tun ist. Kein Chaos.

• Direkter Draht: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Produktionsleitung. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

• 100% Remote & familiäres Umfeld: Komplett aus dem Homeoffice, mit Verständnis für die Lebensrealität von Familien.

• Fixgehalt + Prämienmodell: Planbares Fixum und Prämie bei Zielerreichung.

• Mitspracherecht & Entwicklung: Du gestaltest mit und hast echte Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten.

• Gesundheitsprogramm: Bikeleasing, höhenverstellbare Schreibtische (auch fürs Homeoffice), ergonomische Stühle, Gesundheitsworkshops.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Selbst telefonieren: Du rufst Interessenten an, qualifizierst sie und machst dem Team vor, wie es geht.

• Coachen: Du führst Call-Reviews durch, gibst Feedback und arbeitest neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen ein.

• Führen: Du bist Ansprechperson fürs Team, sorgst für Verbindlichkeit und behältst die Kennzahlen im Blick.

• Mitaufbauen: Du hilfst beim Ausbau des Teams, inklusive Bewerbungsgesprächen.

Requirements
Das bringst du mit:

• Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst: oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle mit viel Kundenkontakt am Telefon.

• Schlagfertigkeit & Energie: Du bist am Telefon souverän, positiv und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus dem Konzept bringen.

• Bestimmt & empathisch: Du sagst klar, was Sache ist, und bleibst dabei menschlich.

• Reflektiert & lernbereit: Du kannst Fehler eingestehen und willst dich ständig verbessern.

• Gefühl für Zahlen: Kennzahlen schrecken dich nicht ab, du leitest daraus gern konkrete Schritte ab.

• Rahmen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, ruhiger Arbeitsplatz zuhause mit stabilem Internet, 30-40 h von Montag bis Freitag.

Keine Führungserfahrung? Kein Problem. Wir bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst, um ein Team gut zu führen.

title: Board Certified Christian Counselor
description:
Are you a compassionate and skilled counselor who integrates Christian faith into mental health practice? Do you want the flexibility to create your own schedule while providing meaningful, faith-based counseling services?
We offer 100% online services, ensuring our clients can access care from the comfort and convenience of their homes. Our services include:

• Faith-Based Counseling
Position Details
This is a contract position with the flexibility to create your own schedule and work remotely. As a Board Certified Christian Counselor, you’ll provide faith-based counseling tailored to the spiritual needs of clients, incorporating evidence-based practices and Christian principles.
Key Responsibilities

• Provide high-quality, client-centered, Christian faith-based counseling via telehealth.

• Support clients in navigating life challenges while incorporating Biblical principles and spiritual guidance.

• Collaborate with clients to develop personalized treatment plans based on their unique needs and spiritual beliefs.

• Maintain clear and timely documentation of client sessions.

• Stay current with continuing education and licensure requirements.

Qualifications

• Board Certification as a Christian Counselor (e.g., certification from the National Christian Counselors Association or equivalent).

• Strong knowledge of Christian principles, theology, and their application in counseling.

• Telehealth experience

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Compassionate, nonjudgmental approach to supporting clients from diverse backgrounds.

Why Join Us?

• Fully Online Services: Provide care in a 100% telehealth model, offering convenience for both you and your clients.

• Flexibility: Create your own schedule and tailor your services to your areas of expertise and passion.

• Competitive Compensation: Earn based on the services you provide, with no cap on potential income.

• Supportive Environment: Join a team that values faith, compassion, and professional excellence.

Salary: $25 - $30 / hour Originally posted on Himalayas
